purpose: Exhaustive coverage inventory before defining any new cohort estimator or exclusion rule
first_exposure_definition: Earliest existing station-group effective month among groups within the stated current scheduled-time threshold
outcome_observed_definition: Published hotel_overnights value is non-missing; suppressed values remain missing and are never replaced by zero
calendar_coverage_definition: Month lies between the earliest and latest month with any published hotel_overnights value in the existing 186-municipality panel
covid_handling_at_this_stage: Count overlap with the existing broad covid_sensitivity_month flag only; do not exclude, adjust or define an official restriction chronology
historical_access_handling: Current accessibility remains fixed. Reuse the targeted 2018 transfer-topology sensitivity only as a labelled diagnostic for municipalities already audited; do not extrapolate it to later cohorts or other thresholds.
selection_policy: No municipality, group, cohort, threshold or horizon is selected or excluded in stage 26
comparison_baseline: The six treated municipalities and their six first-exposure groups from the stage-24 primary pilot are used only to count mechanically additional coverage, never as an eligibility rule
